name: jira
title: Jira Cloud
summary: Jira Cloud REST v3 issues, JQL search, transitions, comments and projects with Atlassian's operation ids, unsigned issue and comment webhooks, and rate-limit, not-found, invalid-field and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: Atlassian publishes the complete Jira Cloud platform OpenAPI description at this URL, unversioned and without a license that clearly allows redistribution, so it is not pinned or fetched. The embedded subset keeps its paths, operation ids and field names; download the full file yourself and point `contract:` at it to mock every operation.
